name: quoxsignal
tagline: Watches your sources, transcribes what matters, drafts the finding.
description: Follows TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and RSS/podcast sources, transcribes new posts, and runs an evidence-gated lens over the transcript before ever showing you a claim. Every proposal cites a verbatim transcript quote or it never surfaces. SCOUT, the triage specialist, explains and challenges verdicts and drafts QuoxPlan stream entries from approved findings. Decisions stay human.
shortDescription: Account-watching, transcription, and evidence-gated proposal triage
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Follows TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and RSS/podcast sources automatically
Evidence-gated proposals: a finding without a verbatim transcript quote is dropped, never invented
SCOUT triage specialist explains and challenges verdicts, cites the transcript, never guesses
Two-tier triage keeps cost trivial: cheap score first, expensive analysis only on survivors
Approved findings hand off to QuoxPlan as a drafted stream entry, human-decided every time

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Every discovered item across every followed source, with triage score, stage, and thumbnail in one scannable list.

sources.name: Sources
sources.description: Follow accounts and feeds across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and RSS/podcasts; see health and last-poll status per source.

proposals.name: Proposals
proposals.description: Evidence-gated findings queued for human decision: approve, reject, or hand off to a QuoxPlan stream entry.

scoutChat.name: SCOUT
scoutChat.description: The signal triage specialist: explains a verdict, argues the counter-case, and drafts a QuoxPlan entry from an approved proposal.

evidenceTrail.name: Evidence Trail
evidenceTrail.description: Every proposal's evidence chain, verifiable back to the transcript quote it was drawn from.

specialist.name: SCOUT
specialist.description: Signal triage analyst: explains and challenges verdicts, drafts QuoxPlan stream entries from approved proposals. Grounded in transcript evidence, never invents a finding.
